extra.text: Since the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON, 55 min OFF.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.3: verify supply at design voltage and 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycling.

extra.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.4: verify test duration of 12 cycles.

extra.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6: inspect interior, then tap and tilt device; pass if no standing pool of water.

extra.text: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.3: verify dust certificate to ASTM C 150-84.

extra.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.6: verify agitation timing (every 15 min, 2 to 15 s) over 5 hours with settling between.

extra.text: As the retro-reflector is combined with a lamp, the rear combination lamp shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
extra.test_case: Remove removable parts; saline mist exposure 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h; verify test sequence completed.

extra.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
extra.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

extra.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
extra.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

extra.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering for a period of 500 hours.
extra.test_case: Verify exposure duration in the weathering log; pass if 500 hours completed.

extra.text: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer, cycle No. 4 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013) is used, the exposure cycle shall be 102 min dry at a broadband irradiance (300 to 400 nm) of 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband irradiance (340 nm) of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
extra.test_case: Check recorded chamber parameters for TM2 cycle; pass if all values remain within the stated tolerances under equilibrium conditions.

extra.text: For the resistance to fuels test of the retro-reflective device, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied.
extra.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1: prepare a test mixture of 70 vol. % n-heptane and 30 vol. % toluol and apply it to the retro-reflector sample. Pass if the mixture composition is verified before the test.

extra.text: After the resistance to fuels test, the surface of the retro-reflective device must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
extra.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): visually inspect the surface about 5 minutes after wiping with 70/30 n-heptane/toluol. Pass if there are no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

extra.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking against paragraph 3.3. and Annex 10 Figure A10-I: the approval number is located adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

extra.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device shall face the same way as the "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking: all approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter "E".

extra.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking: the class symbol group is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

extra.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
extra.test_case: Inspection of the mounting interface: verify positive location (e.g. locating pins, fixed fastener points) so the lamp can only be installed in the intended orientation and position and cannot shift during normal use or servicing. Pass: no inadvertent change of lamp position/aim possible.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (left- and right-hand side) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate being based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
extra.test_case: Measure the installed left and right units on the vehicle (vehicle drawing / CMM) relative to the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of the lamp; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
extra.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry (outer lens, housing, illuminating surfaces) of the left and right units by drawing/CAD mirror check; pass if they are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane, ignoring internal structure.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of the same function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
extra.test_case: Measure the colour of the light emitted / retro-reflected by each function on both left and right units per the applicable device regulation (e.g. UN R148/R150); pass if both units of each pair meet the same colour requirements (red for position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing).

extra.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements of paragraph 5.5 (symmetrical installation of the paired rear lamp functions) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection and measurement of the installed left and right units on the vehicle: verify that geometric symmetry relative to the median longitudinal plane and the colour and photometric matching of each paired function are achieved as far as the asymmetrical body shape allows. Pass if any deviation from symmetry is attributable only to the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape.

extra.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (and any other reciprocally incorporated function) with the rear position lamp simultaneously switched ON; pass if the colour remains within the prescribed red chromaticity limits.

extra.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
extra.test_case: Project the apparent surface parts in the direction of the reference axis onto a plane tangent to the outer lens; pass if projected area is not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or if the gap between facing edges of adjacent parts does not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Activate the stop lamp and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Activate the reversing lamp and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

extra.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, retro-reflector) if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
extra.test_case: Annex 4 geometric check: observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

extra.text: The requirement for simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps with the front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps, side-marker lamps and rear registration plate lamp need not be met while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) the front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
extra.test_case: Vehicle functional test: activate parking lamp mode, daytime running lamps and any front position lamp substitution under paragraph 5.12.1. Check that any switching that is not simultaneous happens only in these listed conditions. Pass: all other operating states meet paragraph 5.11.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light (chromaticity per R48 para 2 definitions / R148 colour specs); pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within white boundaries.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of stop lamp emitted light through outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of rear position lamp emitted light through outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries.

extra.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric check of retro-reflected light under standard illuminant A; pass if chromaticity within red boundaries.

extra.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted (handed left and right units); pass if each count equals the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48 for M1 vehicles.

extra.text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp is fitted as an additional lamp for the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. and is switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, it shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation check: open the movable component to each fixed open position, verify the body-mounted rear position lamp is switched ON and that its mounting position, geometric visibility angles and photometric values meet the requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component; pass if all are met.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position (stable or natural rest position(s) specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not) different from the "normal position of use".
extra.test_case: Installation inspection on M1 vehicle: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position and determine the obscured fraction of the rear position lamp apparent surface in the reference axis direction; pass if obscuration is no more than 50 per cent.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position (stable or natural rest position(s) specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not) different from the "normal position of use".
extra.test_case: Installation inspection on M1 vehicle: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position and determine the obscured fraction of the retro-reflector apparent surface in the reference axis direction; pass if obscuration is no more than 50 per cent.

extra.text: If the 50 per cent obscuration requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
extra.test_case: Functional check: move the movable component to each fixed position where the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden with position lamps ON; pass if the additional lamps switch ON and meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.

extra.text: If the 50 per cent obscuration requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the retro-reflector, additional devices satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for retro-reflectors shall be provided and effective when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
extra.test_case: Installation inspection: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the retro-reflector, verify additional retro-reflecting devices are exposed and meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors.

extra.text: If neither paragraph 5.21 nor 5.21.1 is practicable for the rear position lamp, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road; this alternative does not apply to retro-reflectors.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence and content of the user notice in the vehicle for movable component positions hiding more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp; verify this alternative is not used for the retro-reflector.

extra.text: With the exception of the retro-reflector, each lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp), even bearing an approval mark, shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; otherwise it is deemed not to be present.
extra.test_case: Inspection of the lamp installed on the M1 vehicle: with the light source(s) present and/or the fuse installed and no other modification, activate each function (rear position, stop, reversing) via the vehicle controls. Pass if each function operates; fail if any function requires additional wiring, components or modification to operate.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp light sources. Measure the chromaticity of the replacement function according to the colour requirements for the rear position lamp. Pass if the replacement emits red light similar to the original function.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp. Measure the luminous intensity of the replacement function in the photometric test points for the rear position lamp. Pass if the main intensity is similar to the original rear position lamp function and within its limits.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in position to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation drawings and the lamp. Compare the location (height, width, lateral position) of the replacement function's illuminating surface with that of the original rear position lamp. Pass if the positions are similar and meet the rear position lamp installation requirements.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
extra.test_case: While the replacement is active, activate the original function of the replacement device (e.g. apply the brake). Pass if the original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

extra.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp with the replacement active on the vehicle. Pass if the dashboard tell-tale switches on, indicating a temporary replacement and need for repair, for the whole replacement period.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control responding simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., then the intensity of these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
extra.test_case: Vary the controlling condition (environmental/traffic) over the full control range and measure luminous intensity of both functions; pass if both functions vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, then in the entire intensity range the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
extra.test_case: Measure stop lamp and rear position lamp intensities at multiple points across the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is maintained throughout.

extra.text: If the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp (R2) or stop lamp (S2) is increased or decreased in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface, then the variation shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
extra.test_case: Simulate each environmental condition input and measure luminous intensity at minimum and maximum settings per the photometric test of the pertinent Regulation (e.g. UN R148); pass if intensities stay within the prescribed min/max limits.

extra.text: Independent from environmental conditions, a decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) shall only be activated, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, when the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
extra.test_case: On vehicle/HIL, vary speed and following distance signals; pass if the decrease activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and the reduced intensity is within the prescribed limits.

extra.text: A traffic-condition intensity decrease already activated for the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) shall not remain active when the vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h.
extra.test_case: Activate the decrease, then raise speed signal above 50 km/h; pass if the decrease is cancelled above 50 km/h (it may remain active up to 50 km/h).

extra.text: No sharp variation of intensity of the rear position lamp and stop lamp shall be observed during transition of the variable luminous intensity.
extra.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during intensity transitions (photodetector/oscilloscope); pass if transitions are gradual with no step or sharp change observed.

extra.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the M1 category, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp functions, if they have been tested according to their type approval documentation by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals on the vehicle in a constant voltage operating condition representative for M1, as specified by the applicant. Compare it with the voltage stated in the lamp type approval documentation. Pass if the measured value does not exceed the approved voltage. Confirm the exemption first by checking the lamp documentation for electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the M1 category. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition, measure the voltage at the terminals of each lamp function. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.95 V (6 V system), ≤ 13.905 V (12 V system) or ≤ 28.84 V (24 V system). Check the exemption according to paragraph 5.27.3. first.

extra.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
extra.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp housing, verify that the voltage at the light source terminals complies with paragraph 5.27.2. when the lamp is supplied by the vehicle.

extra.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
extra.test_case: Where masking is identified, carry out photometric measurement of the installed or masked unit, or a simulation with masking applied, at the test points of the device approval regulation. Pass if all prescribed photometric values are still met by the unhidden part.

extra.text: A LED module of the rear combination lamp may be non-replaceable only if this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
extra.test_case: Document and design review: check whether each LED module can be replaced. Pass if the module is replaceable, or if it is non-replaceable and the communication sheet of the component (lamp) type approval states that it is non-replaceable.

extra.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions), when installed on a vehicle, shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Document review: verify valid type approvals per corresponding device Regulations (e.g. UN R148 for position/stop/reversing lamps, UN R150 for retro-reflector) and corresponding approval markings on the device; pass if each installed function is covered by an approval.

extra.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Inspection of lamp for manufacturer logo within apparent surface; if present, verify UN R148 type approval covering the logo (including logo provisions of UN R148 para. 4.5.5); pass if approval exists and marking is present.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp is fitted; pass if present.

extra.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device shall be optional.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamps fitted; pass if 1 or 2 devices are installed.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per R48 measurement provisions; pass if 250 mm <= height <= 1,200 mm.

extra.text: For a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7.: verify unobstructed apparent surface over α = +15°/-5°; pass if visible throughout.

extra.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7.: verify visibility over β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp; pass if visible throughout.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the lamp points rearwards; pass if rearward-oriented.

extra.text: A tell-tale for the reversing lamp is optional; however a tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check component regulation (R23/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale is required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale activation; pass if indicated.

extra.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on M1 category vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

extra.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle in length.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if located at rear.

extra.text: For S1 and S2 category stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, check inward visibility under H plane down to 20°; pass if unobstructed over at least 20° inward below the H plane.

extra.text: Where the S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, check downward visibility; pass if unobstructed over at least 5° downward.

extra.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of stop lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented to rear.

extra.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
extra.test_case: Functional test: with propulsion start/stop device in off position, apply brake; stop lamp operation is permitted but not required; pass in either case, and verify lamps function when propulsion system can operate.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise the tell-tale is optional.
extra.test_case: Check component approval (UN R7/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activates; pass if tell-tale indicates failure.

extra.text: The rear position lamps (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps; pass if exactly two (one per side, handed units).

extra.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark/certificate to UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) for the rear position lamp function; pass if valid approval present.

extra.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle measurement: measure distance from outermost point of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

extra.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle; pass if located at the rear.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: If alternative is claimed: verify rear side-marker lamp fitted, then check unobstructed visibility 45° outward to 45° inward (20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the angles.

extra.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
extra.test_case: Wiring diagram and functional check: verify rear position lamps are switched ON/OFF together with front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps (if any), side-marker lamps (if any) and rear registration plate lamp per paragraph 5.11; pass if compliant.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection on an M1 vehicle: verify rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted; pass if present.

extra.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall be permitted only provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Visual and photometric review of the installation: pass if any additional retro-reflecting devices/materials do not impair visibility or performance of the mandatory lamps.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground with vehicle at specified load condition; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with the rear combination lamp functions (≤ 1,500 mm only where bodywork shape makes compliance impossible, justified).

extra.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Installation inspection of reference axis: pass if the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards.

extra.text: When verifying, according to paragraph 5.10.4., that no red light from the rear combination lamp is visible to the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible to the rear, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
extra.test_case: Install the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Have an observer explore zone 1 (front) and zone 2 (rear) between horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass: within these heights, no red light from the lamp is visible from the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible from the rear.

extra.text: When verifying visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear, the zones 1 and 2 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes that form, to the front and to the rear respectively, an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. These planes shall pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width.
extra.test_case: Determine the overall-width contact points of the vehicle. Construct vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through these points, to the front and to the rear. Pass: within the zones bounded by these planes, no red light from the lamp is visible from the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible from the rear.

extra.text: If there are several points of contact delimiting the vehicle's overall width, the foremost point shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost point to the rearward plane bounding the visibility zones.
extra.test_case: Inspect the vehicle body for multiple overall-width contact points. Pass: zone 1 is constructed through the foremost contact point and zone 2 through the rearmost contact point.

extra.text: The position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, in width, in height and in length, shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: COP check on production vehicle: measure lamp positions in width, height and length per paras 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if measured distances meet each lamp's individual installation specifications.

extra.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: COP check on production vehicle: measure geometric visibility angles per para 2.10.7.; pass if angles meet each lamp's individual specifications, with an allowance of ±3º (para 5.3.).

extra.text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector towards the front shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: COP check on production vehicle per para 5.10.: pass if no red light is directly visible from the front in the zone defined in para 5.10.

extra.text: The visibility of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: COP check on production vehicle per para 5.10.: pass if white light towards the rear is only emitted by the reversing lamp as permitted by para 5.10.

extra.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
extra.test_case: COP functional check on production vehicle against paras 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications (e.g. stop lamp on braking, reversing lamp on reverse gear with ignition on, position lamp with headlamps); pass if all conditions met.

extra.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: COP visual inspection on production vehicle of lamps and markings; pass if presence, number, colour (red for position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing), arrangement and category comply with paras 5.15., 5.16. and individual lamp specifications.
